note: A cassette is keyed on the whole composed prompt, which embeds the model id, the range and the diff. Replaying the fixture therefore has to reproduce all of them, which is why they are recorded here rather than inferred. Note what this does and does not mean: a recording is portable across provider IMPLEMENTATIONS, because it sits at the LLMInput/LLMOutput seam rather than at HTTP — but not across model ids, because the id is part of the request it replays.
